title: SCALES: Boost Binary Neural Network for Image Super-Resolution with Efficient Scalings
problem: Binary neural networks for image super-resolution suffer large performance gap versus floating-point networks due to unhandled pixel-wise, channel-wise, layer-wise and image-wise activation distribution variations.
motivation: Resource-constrained devices need binary quantization for SR without accuracy degradation.
method: SCALES applies multi-granularity input-dependent scaling factors: layer-wise, spatial (pixel-wise), and channel-wise re-scaling, capturing activation distribution variations across SR network depths and spatial dimensions.
key_novelty: Multi-granularity input-dependent scaling enables accurate BNN binarization for SR by capturing diverse activation distributions.
contributions: Layer-wise, spatial, and channel-wise scaling factor design
0.2 dB PSNR improvement over prior art for CNN-based SR
First accurate binary Transformer-based SR network
1+ dB PSNR improvement for binary Transformer variant

metrics.accuracy: 0.2 dB over SOTA CNN-SR, 1+ dB Transformer SR

limitations: Evaluation limited to PSNR metric; generalization to other vision tasks and dynamic range scenarios not discussed.
